acceptance: pr-open refuses when the receipt is missing, stale (tree mismatch) or shows a failed step. Known environment-only failures are listed explicitly, not hidden.
The PR body shows the receipt summary; the hosted gate does not read it.
Docs and the agent guide are updated.
First-CI failure rate is re-measured 4 weeks after merge; target ≤10%.
description: Owner decision D7 (2026-11-07), plan P4 in local://review-practice-integration-plan.md. Today 47 of 286 first CI runs failed and 35% of PRs had a failed CI run. `make pr-preflight` writes a receipt (commands, exit codes, test counts, tree hash). `make pr-open` refuses without a receipt matching the exact tree being pushed, and renders it into the PR body. The receipt is a claim, never an input to the gate.
